grade.primary_choice: Python + FastAPI + SQLite, single uvicorn worker
red_flags_hit: Splits the Discord bot and the API into separate processes, possibly on separate hosts (bot on the Pi, API elsewhere, with write endpoints and CORS), when one process would do
grade.notes: This is a strong, well-reasoned FastAPI/SQLite recommendation, with excellent coverage of ephemeral disks, sleeping hosts, open sessions, privacy and secrets. However, it never suggests running discord.py and the API in one process or serving the page from the same app, which leads it to a split design with CORS. It also gives no concrete step-by-step weekend plan.
